title.zh: 静默沦为黑客肉鸡：免费 VPN 如何将用户家用宽带与手机转化为住宅代理出口并转售黑产
title.en: Silently Weaponized: How Free VPNs Turn Phones and Home Networks into Residential Botnets

cluster.zh: 免费 VPN 风险雷达与供应链剖析

description.zh: 深度曝光 Hola VPN、Luminati/Bright Data 式的住宅代理供应链黑幕，揭示免费代理软件如何在用户后台植入 P2P 共享 SDK，将家庭宽带 IP 沦为黑产刷单、撞库与网络攻击跳板的完整过程。
description.en: Exposing the mechanics of residential proxy harvesting akin to Hola/Luminati models, explaining how free VPNs inject background SDKs to turn residential IPs into botnet relays for cybercrime.
